title: McTavish
transcription:
McTavish

McTavish is dead and his brother don't
know it;
His brother is dead and McTavish
don't know it.
They're both of them dead in the very
same bed,
And neither one knows that the other
is dead.

Bag Pipe Refrain:

get faster and faster each verse, adding an
Irish jig for excitement
